summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DaViz MVP - data visualization platform with AI predictions. All core features tested including dataset management, chart visualizations, CSV upload, and AI-powered predictions using OpenAI GPT-5.2.

ui_bugs.issue: Upload input has 'hidden' class making it not directly testable
ui_bugs.note: This is likely intentional design - input is hidden and triggered by label click

integration_issues.issue: Requires minimum 3 data points but UI doesn't clearly indicate this requirement
integration_issues.note: API returns 400 error when insufficient data, but user guidance could be improved

design_issues.issue: Primary button color is rgb(109, 40, 217) instead of Electric Violet #7C3AED (124, 58, 237)
design_issues.note: Close to design spec but not exact match

passed_tests: Backend API: All 12 endpoints (100% success rate)
Dashboard: datasets list, empty state, navigation
Create Dataset: form validation, column management, dataset creation
Dataset Detail: data table display, add/edit/delete rows
Chart visualizations: bar chart, line chart, pie chart working
AI Prediction: column selection, prediction generation with sufficient data
Responsive design: tablet and mobile layouts
Font rendering: Outfit for headings, Manrope for body text
